editorial:
Imagine a world where a deadly virus has locked everyone inside for years, and only a few people can walk around freely because they are immune. That is the setup for this thriller. You follow Nico, a young courier who can go outside without getting sick, as he tries to reach his girlfriend Sara, who is stuck in quarantine. Along the way, he faces strict martial law, dangerous vigilantes, and a rich, powerful family with dark secrets. The whole thing feels tense and urgent, like a race against time, and it pulls you into a scary version of the near future.

The acting is solid, especially from the leads, and the pacing keeps you on edge the whole time. The action scenes are quick and gritty, and the story moves fast without slowing down much. On the downside, some characters feel a bit thin, and a few plot points are hard to believe. Still, if you enjoy fast thrillers with a pandemic backdrop, this one is worth your time.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Nico breaks into the powerful family's home to rescue Sara. He discovers the family has been hoarding immunity passes and selling them for profit. After a tense showdown, Nico and Sara escape together. The twist is that the family's own daughter turns against them, helping the couple get away. In the end, Nico and Sara reunite and leave the city, finally free from lockdown, while the corrupt family is left exposed.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fast thrillers with a pandemic backdrop.
